headline: Vote to hire a firm for the Malden River Works Salt Shed & Boathouse project, plus a $38,430 designLAB invoice.
summary: Items include construction drawing questions, a review of ranked interview firms, and a vote to hire one. A $38,430 designLAB invoice is also up for approval.
items: Questions or comments on construction drawings from City staff
designLAB update on construction drawings, borings, bid readiness, and other open items

Review of signage requirements for individual rooms and the whole building
Confirming how drawings are listed for each FSB section
Review of soil stockpiling strategy and locations
Review of temporary location and replacement of bin blocks
Adding the Nangle Soil Management Plan to the bid documents
Review and discussion of collated rankings of interviewed firms
Vote to hire a firm, if references are vetted and a favorable price negotiation is reached
